channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: North Palm Beach Celebrates Fourth of July with Fireworks and America 250 Events Today
item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors will celebrate Independence Day with a full day of family-friendly activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.

item.title: Juno Beach residents push for new fence at JB-7 beach access after removal sparks trespassing disputes
item.description: Colony Condos residents say beachgoers have been cutting through private property since the town removed a fence at the JB-7 public beach walkway in 2023. The Juno Beach Town Council will take up the fence question during budget discussions on July 15.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman dies in home fire, community rallies to support fiance
item.description: Friends launched a fundraiser for a Hobe Sound man whose fiance died Monday in a house fire that destroyed the couple's belongings.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to win 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: The City of Riviera Beach was named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League and was the only Florida city selected for the honor this year.

item.title: Saint Andrew's Scots football targets state championship after 10-2 season and district title
item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football program is working hard this summer with the goal of winning a state championship during the 2026 fall season. item.title: Florida advances rules barring undocumented students from state colleges and adult education programs
item.description: Florida's State Board of Education voted to move forward with rules that would prevent undocumented students from enrolling in the state's 28 community colleges and adult education programs. item.title: Hobe Sound woman dies in home fire days before her birthday
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, died Monday in a fire at her Hobe Sound home. Friends are raising money to help her fiance Mark rebuild after the fire destroyed their belongings.

item.title: Driver held teens at gunpoint after Orbeez pellet shooting in Port St. Lucie
item.description: A driver held teenagers at gunpoint after they shot Orbeez pellets at his car in Port St. Lucie, police say.

item.description: Celebrating Independence Day with a cookout for 10 people will cost significantly more this year.
